tests: Resource (Pipeline).Resource when the resource does not exist returns nil
Resource Public when public is not set in the config returns false
Resource Public when public is set to true in the config returns true
Resource Public when public is set to false in the config returns false
Resource Versions with version filters when filter include one field that matches return version that matches field filter
Resource Versions with version filters when filter include one field that doesn't match return no version
Resource Versions with version filters when filter include two fields that match return version
Resource Versions with version filters when filter include two fields and one of them does not match return no version

cases.old:
AND version @> $3
			ORDER BY v.check_order DESC
			LIMIT $2
cases.new:
AND version @> $3
			ORDER BY v.check_order ASC
			LIMIT $2
tests: Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order with no from/to returns the first page, with the given limit, and a next page
Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order when the version has metadata returns the metadata in the version history
Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order when the version has metadata maintains existing metadata after same version is saved with no metadata
Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order when the version has metadata updates metadata after same version is saved with different metadata
Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order when a version is disabled returns a disabled version
Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order when the version metadata is updated returns a version with metadata updated
Resource Versions when check orders are different than versions ids with no from/to returns versions ordered by check order

cases.old:
AND version @> $4
				AND v.check_order <= (SELECT check_order FROM resource_config_versions WHERE id = $2)
			ORDER BY v.check_order DESC
			LIMIT $3
cases.new:
AND version @> $4
				AND v.check_order <= (SELECT check_order FROM resource_config_versions WHERE id = $2)
			ORDER BY v.check_order ASC
			LIMIT $3
tests: Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order with a to that places it in the middle of the versions returns the versions, with previous/next pages
Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order with a to that places it to the oldest version returns the versions, with no next page
Resource Versions when check orders are different than versions ids with to returns the builds, with previous/next pages including to

cases.old:
AND version @> $4
					AND v.check_order >= (SELECT check_order FROM resource_config_versions WHERE id = $2)
				ORDER BY v.check_order ASC
				LIMIT $3
cases.new:
AND version @> $4
					AND v.check_order >= (SELECT check_order FROM resource_config_versions WHERE id = $2)
				ORDER BY v.check_order DESC
				LIMIT $3
tests: Resource Versions when resource has versions created in order of check order with a from that places it in the middle of the versions returns the versions, with previous/next pages
Resource Versions when check orders are different than versions ids with from returns the versions, with previous/next pages including from
